[USER] The user asked for tips on how to store fresh tomatoes to keep them fresh for a longer period.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for storing fresh tomatoes:  
1. Store at room temperature.  
2. Keep them stem-side down.  
3. Don't wash before storing.  
4. Store in a paper bag or breathable container.  
5. Use within a few days.  
6. Ripen tomatoes at room temperature.  
7. Freeze or can excess tomatoes.  
8. Handle gently to avoid bruising.  
9. Avoid strong-smelling foods nearby.  
10. Remove any moldy or soft tomatoes.

[USER] The user asked for tips on how to make a good pasta sauce from scratch using fresh tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for making pasta sauce from scratch:  
1. Choose the right tomatoes (plum or San Marzano).  
2. Roast the tomatoes.  
3. Use a flavorful base (saute onions, garlic, etc.).  
4. Add roasted tomatoes.  
5. Balance acidity and sweetness.  
6. Simmer and reduce.  
7. Season and finish.
